title: Seedance 2.5 generates 30-second video-and-audio scenes in one pass
friendlyTitle: Seedance 2.5 makes longer AI videos with sound and more control
summary: ByteDance launched Seedance 2.5 with single-pass clips of up to 30 seconds, multiple extensions and joint video-and-audio generation. It accepts as many as 30 images, 10 videos and 10 audio clips as references, and adds timestamp-level editing and stronger continuity across shots.
friendlySummary: ByteDance’s new model can make a 30-second video with sound, use many reference files and extend the result into a longer story. It also lets creators edit specific moments.
whyItMatters: Creative teams may be able to replace repeated clip generation and manual stitching with a more controllable storyboard-to-edit workflow. It is rolling out through Jimeng AI and Doubao Pro, with BytePlus API access still to come; quality and rights around uploaded reference material require careful testing.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Video makers may spend less time joining short clips and fixing changes between scenes. They should still test the quality and make sure they have permission to use every reference file.
